notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/0c15d7671f723697cff9454fb0c05187d0cb8180.png"][/img][/p][p][b]"When the god's bell rings, the secrets of the world are revealed."[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Leah, a priestess of Valo Lana from the Executors race of the Catsidhe.[/p][p][/p][p]She has a divine relic left behind in her ruined homeland: the Cat God’s Bell, which holds the power and story of her people and, most importantly, is imbued with the precious memories of her mother.[/p][p]Following Leah's wish to give this precious relic to the Human God, the party heads to the Gwacheon Rift, a place connected to Valo Lana's homeland. There, they encounter mysterious phenomena.[/p][p][/p][p]An unknown seal, a rift turning into a wasteland... and even a talking Abomination steeped in sorrow, wandering the wastes—the 'Mourner'.[/p][p]Uncover the secrets surrounding the God’s Bell and dive into an adventure to reclaim the divine relic![/p]

notes.title: 《Horizon Walker》 Notice
notes.content: [p]Hello, Human God![/p][p][/p][p]We would like to inform you that the issue where Windows Defender was mistakenly detecting components of Horizon Walker as threats has been resolved through cooperation with Microsoft.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, the temporary maintenance for the Steam version has ended, and you can now enjoy Horizon Walker on Steam without any issues.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, as a token of our gratitude for your patience during the Steam launch delay, we have prepared a small compensation for you.[/p][p]\[Compensation for Steam Launch Delay][/p][p]3 FairyNet Multi-Search Tickets[/p][p]1 SS Rank Contract Ticket[/p][p]The compensation will be delivered on August 27 at 14:00 (KST) and can be claimed from your mailbox within 7 days after delivery.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 《Horizon Walker》 Notice
notes.content: [p]Hello, Human God.[/p][p]First of all, we sincerely apologize for the confusion caused while playing the game.[/p][p][/p][p]It has been confirmed that certain versions of Windows Defender are mistakenly detecting components of Horizon Walker as threats.[/p][p][/p][p]While there were no issues during the test version, it is presumed that an unknown misdetection occurred during the Windows Defender update process.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to this issue, the development team has determined that it is currently difficult to open the Steam version, and we are cooperating with Microsoft to identify the cause and resolve the problem.[/p][p][/p][p]Once the issue is resolved, the Steam version will be opened immediately.[/p][p]We are truly sorry to have disappointed you after you’ve been waiting so patiently.[/p][p][/p][p]Any additional updates or progress will be promptly announced through official notices.[/p][p][/p][p]We kindly ask for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
